_om: Elefanten in English (Nellie, rusj.no/en/nellie/) – pairs, the memory card game. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js; the picture labels are in data.en/temaer.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Se godt! Alle kortene vises i tre sekund: Look closely! All the cards are shown for three seconds.
Med «Kikk først» er det et øvingsspill –: With ‘Peek first’ it's a practice game – your record stays as it is.
Bare ett trekk fra rekorden!: Just one move off the record!
Første gang på {hvor} – nå har du en rek: First time on {hvor} – now you've got a record to beat!
Du slo den gamle elefanten – den som ald: You beat the old elephant – the one that never forgets!
Du slo {hvem}. Tør du prøve en som huske: You beat {hvem}. Dare you try one with a better memory?
Elefantungen husket litt mer enn deg den: The baby elephant remembered a bit more than you this time. Try again!
Elefanten husket mest denne gangen. Prøv: The elephant remembered the most this time. Try again – or pick one that remembers a bit less.
Den gamle elefanten glemmer aldri. Prøv: The old elephant never forgets. Try again – or pick one that remembers a bit less.

Can you do it in fewer?
Alle kortene ligger med bildet ned. Snu: All the cards lie face down. Turn them over two at a time – and find the matching pairs.
Trykk på to kort. Er bildene like, har d: Tap two cards. If the pictures match, you've found a pair!
Not a match? Then the cards turn back over. Try to remember the pictures.
Alene: Klarer du det på færrest mulig tr: On your own: can you do it in as few moves as possible? Together or against the elephant: a pair gives you another go, and whoever has the most pairs wins.
Si navnet på bildet høyt når du snur det: Say the name of the picture out loud when you turn it over. That makes it easier to remember.
Mot elefanten: Elefantungen glemmer det: Against the elephant: the baby elephant forgets most things, the elephant remembers quite a lot – and the old elephant never forgets.
Står det likt mellom flere til slutt, bl: If it's a tie at the end, there's a tie-break on a small board.
«Kikk først» viser alle kortene i tre se: ‘Peek first’ shows all the cards for three seconds before you start. Great for little ones – but then the record doesn't count.
